video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | VJ Edgecombe | 10.13.26

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on the team's selfless offensive approach
quotes.excerpt: we just playing unselfish basketball and everyone's just moving, spacing
quotes.quote: I think we just playing unselfish. We just playing unselfish basketball and everyone's just moving, spacing and I think that's what it is, man. Just being unselfish, playing with no egos, just having fun, being able, we're all just happy to share the floor with one another.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe says the Sixers are focused on playing unselfish basketball this season. He noted that the team is prioritizing spacing and playing with no egos to share the floor effectively.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe praises Joel Embiid's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: defensively you're going to get Joel Embiid. He's been really good
quotes.quote: He's been great. Like you say, he's on both ends of the floor. Offensively you're going to get Joel Embiid, defensively you're going to get Joel Embiid. He's been really good, especially defensively. It's been what I've seen the past couple weeks, he's been playing really hard, defending at a high level and just trying to do his best, just protecting the rim and rebounding the ball. He's been great.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe is impressed with Joel Embiid on the defensive end during training camp. He says Embiid has been playing really hard and defending at a high level while protecting the rim.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on the confidence provided by rim protection
quotes.excerpt: I got great rim presence behind me and it just even gives me more confidence
quotes.quote: Most of the time it's going to come down to one-on-one and you have to guard your yard, but I know I got great rim presence behind me and it just even gives me more confidence when it comes to guarding. I got more confidence now that they might not want to go to the rim, so now it becomes a tougher shot, which we're living with.
quotes.social_post: Having Joel Embiid behind him is giving VJ Edgecombe more confidence as a perimeter defender. He says knowing there is great rim presence allows him to guard his yard with more aggression.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on his relationship with teammate Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: JB is one of my favorite people in the world
quotes.quote: JB is one of my favorite people in the world. He's a great person, someone that I talk to every day. He's a leader, he's just Jaylen Brown. He's a great person and that's someone that I just have a really good relationship with, even though we just met a few months ago.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe says he has already formed a close bond with Jaylen Brown. He calls Brown a leader and one of his favorite people despite only knowing him for a few months.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on Baron Filer's confidence and swagger
quotes.excerpt: his confidence is through the roof. Everyone know he plays with such a swagger
quotes.quote: His confidence is through the roof. Everyone know he plays with such a swagger. Obviously we've seen him in college and stuff like that, I played against him in high school. He always had that swagger, he always been confident. I'm just happy to see him on the floor, he's playing really well.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe says Baron Filer is bringing his signature swagger to the Sixers. He noted that Filer's confidence is through the roof and he is happy to see him playing well.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on learning the nuances of point-of-attack defense
quotes.excerpt: I just try to learn, see how they try to manipulate the offensive player
quotes.quote: I just try to learn, see how they try to manipulate the offensive player. The point of attack defense is most important, gets the defense rolling, so I just try to make sure I'm locked in defensively where it forces us not to rotate as much as we'd want to.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe is prioritizing his point of attack defense to help the Sixers avoid unnecessary rotations. He says he is focused on learning how to manipulate offensive players to keep the defense locked in.
